title: Jailed Albanian mayor uses AI avatar to make deepfake speech
key_facts: Tirana Mayor Erion Veliaj, 46, posted an Instagram video, labelled as AI-generated, in which his avatar promises free school meals for all children in the capital.
Veliaj has been in prison in Durres since early 2025 over corruption and financial crime investigations; he denies wrongdoing.
His avatar says it is 'my hostage situation' going on for 20 months and that he will work 'even from my cell'.
Snap mayoral elections set for November 2025 were cancelled after a Constitutional Court decision.
He delegated some duties to deputy mayors and officially stays mayor until local elections in the first half of 2027.
Earlier cases: Imran Khan's 2023 AI message from prison and a Bolsonaro avatar at a July campaign launch.
Albania's AI minister Diella was appointed in autumn 2025.
quote_evidence: Veliaj has been in prison in the coastal city of Durres since early 2025, amid investigations into allegations of corruption and financial crime. He denies any wrongdoing.
"I will keep this promise even from this cell they have locked me in."
In a post on his official Instagram profile, marked as artificial intelligence-generated content
why_it_matters_hint: A jailed politician is still addressing voters through an AI double, following Khan and Bolsonaro.
event_date: video posted around 6 Oct 2026 (exact date not stated)
